text: Implemented deterministic create-only JVM direct and indexed-sharded writer with atomic staging publication, fill omission, exact metadata, SHA-256 receipts, bounded resources, and interruption cleanup. Corrected border chunks to the Zarr v3 full nominal chunk-shape invariant after the independent oracle exposed clipped encoding. Gates: zarrJVM 66/66, zarrJS 64/64; Scala-written rank-5 direct and start-indexed sharded arrays read exactly in Zarr-Python 3.x.
